info.title: FitPulse REST API
info.description: Interactive API documentation for the FitPulse gym management system. Database Project - Second Term.

post.description: Validates user credentials against the database.

error.example: name, category y price son obligatorios

get.description: Returns a class and its scheduled sessions.

post.description: Creates a new scheduled session for an existing class.

error.example: instructor, location, start_time, end_time y max_capacity son obligatorios
Ya existe una sesión de esta clase en esa sede y horario

get.description: Returns the available gym class packages.
Returns the information of a specific package.

error.example: type debe ser upcoming o completed

post.description: Creates a reservation if the session has available capacity.

error.example: La sesión no tiene cupos disponibles
No se puede reservar una sesión que ya comenzó

delete.description: Cancels a reservation without deleting its history.

error.example: No se puede pasar una reserva de cancelled a cancelled

422.description: Reservation cannot be cancelled after session starts

error.example: No se puede cancelar una reserva de una sesión que ya comenzó

patch.description: Changes reservation status according to allowed transitions.

error.example: status debe ser uno de: pending, confirmed, completed, cancelled
La reserva ya está en estado confirmed
No se puede completar una reserva de una sesión que aún no comienza

get.description: Returns purchases with an optional user filter.

post.description: Creates a package purchase. The paid price is set automatically by the server based on the selected package.

get.description: Returns the information of a specific purchase.
Returns daily sales totals and purchase details. If no date is provided, the server uses the current date.

error.example: date debe tener el formato YYYY-MM-DD y ser una fecha real

get.description: Returns reviews with optional user and class filters.

post.description: Creates a review for a completed reservation. Only one review is allowed per reservation.

error.example: Esta reserva ya tiene una reseña
Solo se pueden reseñar reservas de clases ya realizadas (estado completed)

put.description: Updates the rating, comment and tags of an existing review.

get.description: Returns the available tags that can be used when creating or updating a review.

Returns reviews written by a specific user.
